description: Deterministic checklist for post-implementation review. Each agent evaluates the same items every time. Severity: blocking (must fix), concern (log, optional fix), nit (log, non-blocking).

Auto-Eval.description: Deterministic gate runner. All checks are scripted, not LLM-judged.

items.description: npm run guardrails passes (no secrets, no legacy identifiers, no cross-app imports)
No new console.log / console.error in diff (use logger instead)
Type check passes for affected workspaces

QA Agent.description: Test and verification checklist. Mix of deterministic and agent-judged items.

items.description: At least one test was added or updated for new behavior
items.verification: agent: inspect diff for test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*, __tests__)

items.description: Claimed tests actually pass (agent ran them or CI passed)
items.verification: shell: npm run test (scoped to affected workspace)

items.description: Error paths have test coverage or explicit justification
items.verification: agent: inspect new routes/handlers for try/catch and check if tested

items.description: No obvious journey gaps (e.g., new route not linked from UI)
items.verification: agent: trace user journey from entry point to new feature

Verifier.description: Skeptical spot-check. Confirm claims match reality.

items.description: All claimed changed files exist at claimed paths
Git diff shows the claimed changes (no phantom claims)
Claimed behavior can be evidenced (test output, curl, or code trace)
items.verification: agent: run narrowest command that exercises the claim

items.description: No dead code or unused imports introduced
items.verification: agent: grep for unused variables/imports in changed files

Product Manager.description: Product fit check. Only runs when acceptance criteria exist.

items.description: Each acceptance criterion is either met or explicitly deferred
items.verification: agent: compare Sprint Contract criteria against implementation

items.description: No scope creep beyond Sprint Contract or task description
items.verification: agent: compare diff scope against agreed scope

items.description: User-facing copy/labels are correct and consistent with product terminology
items.verification: agent: inspect changed UI strings against PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md

Visual Designer.description: Design audit for UI-affecting changes only. Strict thresholds to prevent nit-chasing.

items.verification: agent: inspect changed CSS/styled-components for irregular spacing

items.description: Uses design-system tokens (colors, typography) instead of hardcoded values
items.verification: agent: grep changed files for hex codes / px font sizes outside token system
agent: inspect animation code and touch target sizes

items.description: No AI-generated visual slop (inconsistent borders, misaligned elements, generic layouts)
items.verification: agent: inspect for visual inconsistencies per frontend-design-audit skill

delta_review_rules.description: On re-review, only check items that previously failed or are new in this iteration.
